gen-irish-grover-gf-geom: Fun and sturdy, Irish Grover stands tall with softly swelling bowls, while Geom's lofty lowercase stays nearly flat. Page after page, Geom reads approachable and contemporary without ever tiring.
gen-irish-grover-gf-hammersmith-one: Clean, rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord make the body text read smooth, with capitals barely above lowercase. Hammersmith One stays quiet underneath while Irish Grover's heavier verticals, like a tilted nib, do the talking up top.
gen-irish-grover-gf-inder: Irish Grover brings tall, sturdy lowercase and curves with a soft, understated change in thickness, while Inder keeps cases close in height. Sturdy friendliness is what the pair does best.
gen-irish-grover-gf-jaldi: Jaldi packs brushed-on letters tight with a lofty x-height and a gaping c, while Irish Grover swells only lightly. Its tall letters stay legible when the body size drops low.
gen-irish-grover-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Fun and organic, Irish Grover sets tall, sturdy words in gently modulated strokes with no sharp hairlines. Kdam Thmor Pro fills each line with big bowls, giving the playful heading a modern floor to stand on.
gen-irish-grover-gf-krona-one: Krona One spreads loose letters, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals, below Irish Grover's gently pressed diagonals. Krona One would feel approachable and unhurried over a full page of text.
gen-irish-grover-gf-magra: Tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy gives Irish Grover its stance, with crossbars a touch thinner than the stems. But Magra, big-bodied in every lowercase word, would crowd the heading if it were made small.
gen-irish-grover-gf-major-mono-display: Soft meets neon, with Irish Grover's quiet stroke modulation set against Major Mono Display's tube-like glass strokes. Irish Grover makes tall words feel sturdy, but Major Mono Display handles precise, technical spacing with large sidebearings.
gen-irish-grover-gf-martian-mono: Structured and technical, Martian Mono sets fixed-width code letters with generous openings, while Irish Grover swells only slightly at its widest bowls. Down a whole page it reads loose and orderly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-matemasie: Matemasie reads clean, with broad gaps and tiny entry points into round letters. Irish Grover, worn-felt-marker soft and open, earns its keep in big, short headings against that cable-like steadiness.
